items.title: Stella Oliver Interview, 1959-04-22
items.q: That was Celestine. That passed recently.

ctx.x: And he would take these eggs and he'd go on blowing. They'd get out of the corner and the people would gang around them. Sometimes on Sunday, there were two bands. They'd meet on this corner. And one would try to play the other. Play out the other. That was Celestine. That passed recently. Yes. And all the other bunch.
And it was like a Mardi Gras day. Everybody was out to hear the band.
